segments.title: Chương 271: 0273 [Kẻ thua cuộc hoàn toàn]
segments.content:
Two girls walked together, looking quite intimate, while Chen Guiliang was pushed to the side.

Intimate my ass.

In everything she said, Bian Guanyue was constantly declaring her sovereignty: "When Zijié and Youke were first founded, this office building hadn't even been built yet. Back then, we were crammed into a small office, and I even bought the potted plant. It's in his office now. The cactus, have you seen it?"

"I don't usually go to places like offices," Tao Xue said as if she didn't understand, like an obedient, well-behaved child. "Back when I was at home, I never went into my brother's study. My brother said men also have their own private space, and it's better for girls not to disturb them."

Their conversation was all like this, making Chen Guiliang's heart pound with every word.

Neither of them knew where they were going; they just walked into the elevator, "chatting and laughing" like that.

Chen Guiliang could only follow them in.

"I didn't do well on my exam this time, just a little over the tier-one university cutoff. Sigh, I can only apply to Minzu University of China," Tao Xue sighed repeatedly, then suddenly changed the subject. "But it's pretty good too, it's very close to Peking University, so I can come over to visit every weekend."

Bian Guanyue said, "You should still work hard in university, you can't just think about having fun all the time. Girls need to have their own careers too. I was delayed by studying vocal music in middle and high school, so I didn't study my academic subjects properly. Only now do I realize I need to work hard. I'm studying my own major, and also self-studying courses like Ethnic Music Theory and Analysis of Traditional Chinese Music Forms. When I apply for a master's in ethnic music research, my past vocal lessons and academic studies won't have been wasted."

Tao Xue said with surprise, "Wow, you're going for a master's, Xuejie? Which school are you applying to?"

"The Central Conservatory of Music," Bian Guanyue said.

Tao Xue said, "That's so impressive. I'm not doing a master's, high school almost made me sick of studying."

The elevator reached the ground floor.

Chen Guiliang stood inside, waiting for them to exit first.

Outside the elevator, a few people were also waiting.

"CEO Chen!"

Wang Kai, the head of the incubation department at Peking University Science Park, greeted him with a broad smile.

He used to mainly call him "Xiao Chen," occasionally calling him "CEO Chen" as a joke, but now it had completely changed to "CEO Chen."

Especially after Wang Kai got promoted.

Chen Guiliang smiled and shook his hand. "CEO Wang, are you still personally showing people around offices?"

Wang Kai introduced, "This is Mr. Wang Song, an alumnus from the '86 class of the Peking University Department of Mathematics. His company, Lanxun Communications, is moving its R&D headquarters here."

"A pleasure, a pleasure. I've long heard of your name," Chen Guiliang said, quickly shaking hands with Wang Song.

Zijie Tiaodong, Youxi Kexue, and Tudou.com had all become clients of Lanxun Communications over the past two years.

This company specialized in content delivery networks, which could make news images and web pages load faster, reduce update package download latency, and make video streaming smoother.

CCTV.com also partnered with Lanxun Communications for their Olympic broadcasts.

Even government departments and institutions like the State Administration of Taxation and the Bank of China were currently clients of Lanxun Communications.

The company's market share would reach 60% next year, providing services to 80% of China's internet companies.

When Wang Song shook hands with Chen Guiliang, he said, "I've also heard a lot about you, CEO Chen, especially in the last few days."

"I'm ashamed, I couldn't help but say a few extra words during my speech," Chen Guiliang said.

Regarding the dispute between Chen Guiliang and Robin Li, Wang Song's opinion was actually very simple: two junior schoolmates from Peking University were arguing.

Chen Guiliang asked Wang Kai, "Are there still vacant offices in this building?"

Wang Kai explained, "The regular offices are all leased out, but we've reserved some specifically for various high-tech labs and research institutions."

They weren't in a hurry to go upstairs and stood outside the elevator chatting with Chen Guiliang.

Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue also stopped their bickering and took the initiative to find a sofa in the first-floor lobby to sit down.

Wang Kai said, "SuperMap Software will also be moving in. They came to look at an office half a month ago. The two of you might have a chance to cooperate. SuperMap is always developing clients. If Xiaonei and Hainei are interested, you can use SuperMap to develop applications."

"Then I'll have to chat with them when I have the chance," Chen Guiliang said.

The current Google Maps had an offset problem in China; SuperMap, on the other hand, was more accurate. Of course, SuperMap had many problems of its own.

Next year, SuperMap would also take on the Olympic transportation project, completely cementing its industry position in China.

Xiaonei and Hainei could cooperate with SuperMap to add new website features: users could tag locations when uploading photos, see nearby friends, and initiate offline gatherings. It could also generate friend distribution heatmaps, and so on.

When the technology matured and SuperMap became more accurate in the future, they could also integrate university maps into Xiaonei and provide location-tagging services for businesses on and off campus.

When the smartphone era arrived and cloud computing technology emerged, and SuperMap couldn't keep up with the times, Chen Guiliang could also poach a few talented people from them.

The same went for Lanxun Communications, which would decline because it missed the cloud computing wave. Chen Guiliang could take the opportunity to poach people then too.

After chatting for a good ten minutes, Wang Kai and Wang Song finally took the elevator upstairs.

Chen Guiliang walked over to the sofa in the lobby. "Have you two decided where you want to go?"

Bian Guanyue said, "Not yet."

Tao Xue said, "Let's go to Beihai Park! We actually forgot to go when we were in the capital last summer vacation. My parents have been talking about it, saying that when they were students, their textbooks even had pictures of boating in Beihai Park."

Chen Guiliang looked at Bian Guanyue.

Bian Guanyue said, "Let's go, let's go boating together."

The three of them went out to hail a taxi.

Chen Guiliang was too lazy to drive himself. Who knew how many places they would go today? Driving around looking for parking would be inconvenient.

He didn't ask Yang Shuo to be his driver either, because the situation today was special.

The taxi stopped, and Chen Guiliang went straight for the front passenger seat, chatting with the driver about everything under the sun.

Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue sat in the back, not speaking a word the whole way, each looking out the window at the street scenery.

When they arrived at Beihai Park, Chen Guiliang went to rent a boat and buy tickets.

Seeing that Chen Guiliang had temporarily left, Bian Guanyue finally couldn't hold back. "Do you know that I'm his girlfriend?"

"I know." Tao Xue's expression showed a hint of disappointment, but she deliberately feigned a nonchalant attitude.

Bian Guanyue said, "You still act like this even though you know?"

Tao Xue muttered, "I just see him as a good friend and a big brother. I like hanging out with him, so I came to find him. You can't just monopolize him and not let him have other friends, can you?"

Bian Guanyue really wanted to curse her as "shameless," but she held the words back and even smiled. "Are you thirsty? I'll go buy you a drink."

Tao Xue: ???

When Chen Guiliang returned after renting the boat, he found that Bian Guanyue's attitude had completely changed. She seemed to have become the hostess, and Tao Xue a visiting sister-in-law. She had even taken the initiative to buy Tao Xue a cold drink.

She called her "Xiao Xue" this and "Xiao Xue" that, with extraordinary affection.

Although they were no longer bickering, she had adjusted her method of struggle!

She was asserting her status as the official girlfriend, yet in a way that wouldn't make Chen Guiliang feel awkward.

This, in turn, gave Tao Xue a deep sense of powerlessness. Occasionally, she would say a few provocative words to Bian Guanyue, but Bian Guanyue acted as if she didn't understand, and instead became even more considerate and caring toward Tao Xue.

Tao Xue found that she had become the "little sister," while Bian Guanyue was already her "sister-in-law."

What to do?

Chen Guiliang slowly pedaled the boat, feeling the breeze from the lake, and made small talk. "It really is nice here. A good place to relax when it's not too hot or too cold."

Tao Xue, at a complete disadvantage, could only play up her lively and cute side, singing like a little girl, "Let us paddle the oars, the little boat..."

"The little boat pushes through the waves..." Bian Guanyue joined in as well.

Tao Xue suddenly didn't want to sing anymore, because she couldn't sing as well as Bian Guanyue.

Ahhhhh, this is so annoying, how is she better than me at everything!

I've lost, lost so miserably.

At this moment, Tao Xue felt so wronged she wanted to cry.

After boating for a while, Tao Xue didn't want to stay in Beihai Park anymore. It had become a place of sorrow for her.

She would never come here again in this lifetime!

"Xuezhang, let's go listen to some crosstalk," Tao Xue suggested.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Since when did you like crosstalk?"

Tao Xue said, "There's a crosstalk comedian on Tudou.com who's gotten quite popular recently, called something-something Gang."

"Guo Degang," Chen Guiliang said.

At Chen Guiliang's suggestion, Tudou.com had already adjusted its operational strategy. While quietly stockpiling film and television copyrights, it had also exclusively signed some artists and internet celebrities, including Hu Ge and Guo Degang.

Guo Degang had already become famous at the end of last year, but it was mainly traditional media reporting on him, with quite a few people discussing him on Tieba and forums as well.

Chen Guiliang had suggested Tudou.com sign Guo Degang's exclusive online copyrights, causing Guo Degang's crosstalk to become popular on the internet ahead of time.

However, that wasn't what Tao Xue wanted to express.

What she really wanted to say was: Xuezhang, I've been paying close attention to your company and the companies you've invested in. I even know about the crosstalk comedian who got popular on Tudou.com.

"Go listen to crosstalk?" Chen Guiliang sought Bian Guanyue's opinion.

Bian Guanyue, seemingly having truly become a doting sister-in-law, smiled and said, "Since Xiao Xue likes it, let's go."

Tao Xue silently screamed in her heart: Xuezhang, look how good she is at pretending, don't be fooled by her!

The shabby place where Guo Degang performed crosstalk at the time was only about five kilometers from Beihai Park. It was a short taxi ride away.

Chen Guiliang went to the teahouse to inquire and found out there was a performance at two o'clock on Saturday afternoon. The front row tickets were 60 yuan, a bit pricey for that time.

"Let's go eat first. We have tickets for the afternoon," Chen Guiliang said.

During the meal, Bian Guanyue was incredibly attentive, even helping Tao Xue arrange her bowl and chopsticks.

Her attitude was as if to say: It's not easy for my sister-in-law to visit, so as her sister-in-law, I must be a good hostess.

Tao Xue was about to go crazy. All the punches she threw landed on cotton.

She would rather Bian Guanyue bicker with her, or even argue and curse at her.

Bian Guanyue's gentle and considerate behavior made Tao Xue too embarrassed to say anything strange anymore, otherwise, how bad would it sound to Chen Guiliang? If she continued to "act unreasonably," her image in front of Chen Guiliang would be completely ruined.

Chen Guiliang observed silently, thinking to himself how terrifying this was.

Bian Guanyue had become a master of domestic drama without any formal training!

After lunch, it was still early before the crosstalk show started, so the three of them went for a stroll nearby.

Diagonally across from the teahouse was the Tianqiao Antique Market, with everything from coins, stamps, old books, porcelain, and jade to even bronze artifacts.

Especially those bronze artifacts—if even one of them were real, it would be enough to land the stall owners in prison for a few years.

Tao Xue was surprisingly very interested in these things, because she was a loyal fan of "Ghost Blows Out the Light."

"Is this the Panjiayuan from the book?" Tao Xue asked curiously.

Chen Guiliang said, "This is Tianqiao. Panjiayuan is further east."

Tao Xue walked up to a stall and stared at the various antiques for a long time.

The stall owner enthusiastically greeted her, "Young lady, what have you taken a fancy to? Everything I have here is top quality. Look at this bronze wine cup, genuine Western Zhou..."

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: Why did you have to mention Western Zhou? Now you're reminding me of last week's old joke again.
